sources.title: dbtagger · Danbooru tag explorer
sources.snippet: Danbooru prompt intelligence Find the tags your model understands. Many anime image models and checkpoints learned from captions built with Danbooru tags. dbtagger turns tag co-occurrence into a practical map: discover related concepts and artists, use vocabulary from your model's training era, then copy a prompt-ready list.

sources.title: GitHub - anthony-dipofi/danbooru-tagger: Pytorch code for tagging ...
sources.snippet: Pytorch code for tagging dabooru images Includes a pretrained model for tagging danbooru images. Trained on the Danbooru2019 512x512 SFW subset to predict the 6000 most common 'Category 0' tags. Achieves an F2 score of 0.61 on hold out test set, with a threshold of 7.9. For more performance information see the test_tagger.ipynb notebook.
